title: MSM Trace Element \(TE) solution
protocol: Adjust the pH of water to around 2.5.
Add 1100 mg/l FeCl₃ x6H₂O into the water, dissolve it thoroughly.
Add 50 mg/l CuSO₄ x5H₂O into the solution, dissolve it thoroughly.
Add 200 mg/l HBO₃ into the solution, dissolve it thoroughly.
Add 200 mg/l MnSO₄ xH₂O into the solution, dissolve it thoroughly.
Add 80 mg/l Na₂MoO₄ x2H₂O into the solution, dissolve it thoroughly.
Add 60 mg/l CoCl₂ x6H₂O into the solution, dissolve it thoroughly.
Add 90 mg/l ZnSO₄ x7H₂O into the solution, dissolve it thoroughly.
Add 10 mg/l Na₂SeO₄ into the solution, dissolve it thoroughly.
Adjust the pH to 1.5 with sulfuric acid and/or sodium hydroxide.
